on_shelf.label: Philosophy of History, Introduction
on_shelf.text: If then we cast a glance over the "World's-History generally, we see a vast picture of changes and transactions; of infinitely manifold forms of peoples, states, individuals, in unresting succession. Everything that can enter into and interest the soul of man — all our sensibility to goodness, "beauty, and greatness — is called into play.

on_shelf.label: Philosophy of Mind §527
on_shelf.text: Where civil society, and with it the State, exists, there arise the several estates in their difference: for the universal substance, as vital, exists only so far as it organically particularises itself.

presented_event_with_attribution: Shri G. Hegde says: “You just called me Shri Hegde in the middle of my own rant. I am the one who is supposed to be here, not the one you are arguing with. Just get the boy or I'm moving the car.” He grips the steering wheel tighter and glances at his watch.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: Shri Hegde, I trust the morning has treated you well. I have reviewed the file you left, and I see the discrepancy in the names. It appears a simple clerical error has displaced me into your allotted residence. I am prepared to discuss the transfer of this property to its rightful owner at your earliest convenience, provided we can do so with the due formality that the State requires.

typed_records.speaker: Shri G. Hegde
typed_records.words: Salaam. The morning is fine, though the traffic on Tughlak Road was a nightmare this morning. Please, sit down; the tea is finally ready. We can certainly sort out the file, but let us not rush the formality before the clerk arrives to witness it.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: Salaam, Shri Hegde. Please, sit. The traffic is a matter of civil society's friction, which I expect here. As for the file, I am ready to draft the reply now. We need only the clerk's presence to witness the transfer of the keys and the correction of the record. Let us not allow the comfort of the hour to obscure the necessity of the correction.

typed_records.speaker: Shri G. Hegde
typed_records.words: You speak in circles, sir. I am here to take possession of the bungalow, not to draft your philosophical replies. Please, just get the clerk; I have a long drive back to the office after this.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: You are correct, Shri Hegde. The form is the content. I will instruct the clerk to prepare the handover immediately. Please, accept my apologies for the delay in the machinery.

typed_records.speaker: Shri G. Hegde
typed_records.words: Save it for your file, sir. I don't need a lecture on machinery, I need the keys and the signed papers before the office starts calling. Get the clerk.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: You are correct, Shri Hegde. The abstract must become concrete. I shall send for the clerk to rectify the record and issue the keys. The machinery follows the law; it does not precede it.

typed_records.speaker: Shri G. Hegde
typed_records.words: Whatever it is, just send the boy. I've got a two-hour drive to Dwarka before the traffic chokes completely.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: The state is not a road, Shri Hegde. It is the ethical idea made actual. One does not drive through it; one lives within it. Please, send the boy.

typed_records.speaker: Shri G. Hegde
typed_records.words: Bhai, stop with the philosophy, I’m not a student. If you can’t send the clerk in the next five minutes, I’m walking out and calling the Director myself. The traffic won’t wait for your ethical ideas.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: Shri Hegde, I do not require a clerk to acknowledge a fact. The file is in my possession, and the error is evident. I will draft the correction immediately. Please, remain.

typed_records.speaker: Shri G. Hegde
typed_records.words: You just called me Shri Hegde in the middle of my own rant. I am the one who is supposed to be here, not the one you are arguing with. Just get the boy or I'm moving the car.

typed_records.text: Read the newspapers on the step to gauge the state of the world and the local storm.
Draft a formal reply to Shri Hegde regarding the clerical error in the allotment file.
Walk to the Indian Institute of Culture to observe the spiritual dimension of this land.
Return home to rest and reflect on the tension between caste and statehood.
Visit Lodhi Gardens to sit among the tombs and contemplate the transience of rule.
